name: Snuffers
overview: Scripture reveals that snuffers were essential temple utensils used in the maintenance of the sacred lamps, as indicated by their mention alongside bowls, basons, and spoons in the service of the house of the LORD. These instruments, often made of precious metals like gold and brass, were provided specifically for the temple's holy duties, highlighting the care and reverence given to God's sanctuary. The removal of snuffers and other vessels during times of judgment underscores their role in the proper worship and ministry within the temple.
